subject: Goalposts agreement and test sprint — MAP / Eval acceptance
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Brown <alex.brown@healthlytics.com>, Procurement <contracts@healthlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Goalposts agreement and test sprint — MAP / Eval acceptance

Alex / Jordan / Contracts team — attaching an updated MAP (v2) and a starter evaluation test sheet. This thread is to lock the acceptance criteria and the short timeline for the evaluation sprint so we can sign the SOW and schedule Dedicated capacity. Highlights I want agreed by EOD Friday: 

- Exit gate 1 (functional): Redwood serving runtime returns responses for the sample prompts in evaluation_tests.xlsx with consistent formatting and no runtime errors.
- Exit gate 2 (latency): 95th percentile per-request latency <= 450ms for the defined 512-token scenario on Dedicated pool.
- Exit gate 3 (accuracy): For the provided 50 prompt set, HealthLytics marks >= 85% of generations as "acceptable" per column B in the spreadsheet.
- Exit gate 4 (security): No PII leakage in the redacted test set; SOC2 evidence checklist items A1–A4 completed.

Deliverables attached: MAP_draft_v2.pdf (mutual timeline, owners, and rollback triggers), evaluation_tests.xlsx (prompt set and pass/fail rubric), SOW-draft.docx (commercial draft).

Please: 1) Confirm the four gates above or propose edits, 2) Call out any additional acceptance tests you require (e.g., throughput at 100 concurrent workers), and 3) Confirm a feasible 2-week window to run the tests starting Nov 16.

If we can align by Friday 11/13 we'll lock the SOW and a Nov 23 start for Dedicated capacity.

Thanks —
Diego
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MAP_draft_v2.pdf (PDF, 482 KB)]
[Attachment: evaluation_tests.xlsx (XLSX, 76 KB)]
[Attachment: SOW-draft.docx (DOCX, 128 KB)]

From: Alex Brown <alex.brown@healthlytics.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <contracts@healthlytics.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@healthlytics.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Goalposts agreement and test sprint — MAP / Eval acceptance

Diego — thanks for the clear draft. Quick notes from our side after a brief review: 

1) Functional test set: the prompt variety looks good; we'll add 10 more edge-case prompts that reflect our clinical coding variations (I'll upload by 11/10).
2) Latency: 450ms p95 is ambitious for our worst-case 512-token examples. Can we instead do p95 <= 600ms or create a tier: p95 <= 450ms for cached/prefix cases and p95 <= 600ms for cold-start?
3) Accuracy definition: we'll use the rubric but add a secondary auto-reranking pass. If auto-rerank pushes overall acceptable rate to >= 90% we'll treat that as a bonus SLA credit — details in procurement redlines.
4) Security checklist: Procurement will need the SOC2 scoping memo and KMS integration note. Contracts asked to see logs retention policy before signing.

Proposed acceptance timeline: test window Nov 18–25 (we have internal reviews week of Nov 16). Can you confirm Redwood can reserve Dedicated capacity for Nov 18–25 and provide a small sandbox region with telemetry access?

Thanks — Alex
Alex Brown
Head of Product, HealthLytics

[On Mon, Nov 9, 2026 at 09:12 AM Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai> wrote:]
> Alex / Jordan / Contracts team — attaching an updated MAP (v2) and a starter evaluation test sheet. This thread is to lock the acceptance criteria and the short timeline for the evaluation sprint so we can sign the SOW and schedule Dedicated capacity.

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Goalposts agreement and test sprint — MAP / Eval acceptance

Marissa / Monica — forwarding Alex's notes. Key asks we need to answer by EOD Thursday: 

- Decision on latency split (450ms vs tiered 450/600ms). If we accept tiered we must document which requests are "cached/prefix" vs "cold-start" and how autoscaling will be handled.
- Confirm Dedicated reservation Nov 18–25 (we should block now and cancel if needed). Cost note: short-term reservation will increase monthly commitment by ~8% for that pool.
- Monica: can your team run the auto-rerank + client-side reranking pipeline during the window and provide telemetry access?

I'll draft the short FAQ for contracts and attach it to the MAP.

Diego

----
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Brown <alex.brown@healthlytics.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Goalposts agreement and test sprint — MAP / Eval acceptance

Alex / Diego — we can absolutely run the rerank + additional evaluation harness. Quick clarifications: 

- Test environment: we will spin up a sandbox Dedicated pool in us-west-2 with the same instance shapes as the proposed production pool. Telemetry will be provided via a shared Prometheus + Grafana link and a read-only S3 bucket for raw logs.
- Data: please provide a redacted sample (~200 records) by Nov 13. If you can't share data, send a data schema and representative synthetic set.
- Acceptance automation: we'll ingest evaluation_tests.xlsx, run the pass/fail scripts, and produce a short report (results.csv + failure-samples.json) within 48 hours of test completion.

For the latency split: I'm ok with tiered acceptance if we define the cached vs cold-start indicators. Proposal: label each prompt in evaluation_tests.xlsx with a required prefix length and cache status. Cached scenarios count toward the stricter p95 target.

I'll start the Dedicated reservation as 'provisionally booked' Nov 18–25 and flag finance for the short-term commitment.

Monica Patel
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: internal_test_plan.md (TXT, 12 KB)]

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Brown <alex.brown@healthlytics.com>, Procurement <contracts@healthlytics.com>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@healthlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 14:43:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Goalposts agreement and test sprint — MAP / Eval acceptance

Alex / Jordan / Contracts — thanks for the fast turn. We've updated the MAP (v2.1) with the tiered latency gate and added a section mapping prompts to cache status. Actions and next steps: 

- HealthLytics: upload edge-case prompts + redacted sample data by EOD 11/13.
- Redwood: provision Dedicated sandbox for Nov 18–25 (provisionally reserved). Monica to share telemetry links by 11/16.
- Contracts: we'll push a short SOC2 scoping memo and log-retention excerpt to the shared Drive by 11/13.
- Post-test: Redwood will deliver results.csv and failure-samples.json within 48 hours; HealthLytics will provide final acceptance decision within 3 business days after receipt.

If that timeline works we'll convert the SOW to a signature-ready DocuSign by COB 11/13 and route to Procurement. I've attached the updated SOW and MAP to this note.

Cheers —
Diego Fernandez
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
